About AlUla​

Located in the Medina Province of Saudi Arabia, AlUla is a hidden gem nestled 1,100 kilometers northwest of Riyadh and approximately 679 kilometers from the bustling city of Jeddah. This captivating destination is renowned for its breathtaking natural beauty, offering an impressive array of activities for nature lovers and adventure seekers alike. Visitors can embark on scenic hikes through dramatic sandstone canyons, wind-carved rock formations, and sprawling desert landscapes rich in history and geological wonder. Beyond its stunning vistas, AlUla has a vibrant cultural scene, where history and art merge seamlessly.

From the ancient streets of AlUla’s Old Town, filled with the echoes of its storied past, to contemporary art installations set against the rugged beauty of the canyons, this unique region provides endless discoveries.

Waytransit Travels & Tourism offers the best AlUla travel packages, providing unforgettable experiences and exclusive deals for travelers exploring Saudi Arabia’s hidden gem.

Signature Experiences:​

Immerse yourself in AlUla’s stunning natural wonders, where thrilling adventures and rich history await. Experience the excitement of abseiling down towering cliffs or ziplining over dramatic canyons, offering breathtaking views of the desert landscape. For those who prefer to explore on foot, hike through secluded valleys, discovering the hidden beauty of AlUla’s ancient rock formations. Wander through the maze-like streets of AlUla’s historic Old Town, where every alley whispers tales of its storied past, from ancient architecture to bustling markets. With a diverse range of activities and sights, AlUla promises an unforgettable experience for every traveler.

AlUla Moments:

Explore AlUla's vibrant calendar with a comprehensive guide to its extraordinary events throughout the year. From mega music and wellness festivals to sports, heritage events, and art exhibitions, AlUla promises a diverse range of special events catering to every interest.

    Places

    to Explore:​​

    AlUla reveals a stunning array of attractions, from the ancient tombs of Dadan to the awe-inspiring UNESCO World Heritage Site of Hegra, and the modern mirrored installations that enhance its breathtaking valley. The blend of natural beauty and architectural marvels makes AlUla one of the most captivating destinations in the world, waiting to be explored.

    AlUla Luxury Package

    Description

    AlUla is the ultimate luxury destination, offering a perfect fusion of ancient wonders and modern elegance. This enchanting oasis provides discerning travelers with an unparalleled experience. Stay in lavish accommodations that blend seamlessly with AlUla’s breathtaking landscapes, creating a sanctuary of comfort and sophistication. Discover the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Hegra, a remarkable testament to ancient civilizations, and stroll through the historic charm of AlUla Old Town. Indulge in gourmet dining under the desert’s starlit sky, including exclusive Michelin-star restaurants. Whether it’s attending world-class cultural events or enjoying personalized adventure activities, AlUla caters to the most refined tastes. Immerse yourself in AlUla’s rich history while experiencing the unmatched luxury that defines this extraordinary and exclusive destination.

    AlUla Wellness Festival Packages

    AlUla Wellness Festival - Recharge your Mind, Body and Soul!

    Fitness, wellbeing, and rejuvenation
    AlUla Wellness Festival is a celebration of personal growth, fitness and holistic wellbeing, set in one of the world’s most naturally energising landscapes. From athletic events to mindfulness and movement, music, and nourishment, the festival invites guests of all levels to reset, recharge, reconnect and strive – physically, emotionally, and spiritually. Whether you’re a Serenity Seeker in search of stillness or a Beat Chaser fuelled by rhythm and energy, the festival offers intense challenges and curated moments of calm. It fosters both personal transformation and a powerful sense of community, all grounded in the beauty and authenticity of AlUla.
